posts.title: Google Continues to Suck
posts.description: As if I needed another reason to get rid of Google as much as I possibly can, here’s another: Google Will Turn Off Search for Schools That Reject A.I. What a completely shitty company.
One can only hope we do not ruin these election results by excessive gloating. Let’s not make the same mistakes again.
